resolvedFinding.issue: group-still-present was a valid cleanup result missing from the diagnostic enum, which could discard the safe diagnostic on an existing primary failure.
resolvedFinding.resolution: The enum now includes it and a finish-to-public-to-unittest-receipt negative test preserves failed status and the cleanup classification.

assessment.selection: Wrappers observe the actual one rows() call. They return original API values, preserve escaping API exception identity, restore original methods, and add no candidate selection, enumeration retry or fallback.
assessment.lifetime: An explicit child readiness acknowledgement and exact-child WNOWAIT observations bracket selection. Unavailable stays unavailable; exit-pending is distinct from live. The dedicated child session and readiness are new controlled preconditions, not a proven historical fix.
assessment.predicates: Candidate absence, BSD gone reads, executable-path mismatch, filtered presence and birth/argv row mismatch are separated by fixed fields and independent static assertion lines. The original strict inclusion assertion remains.
assessment.unknown: Unobserved candidate/filtered counts remain null; known read counters start at zero. selectionFailureTargetsChild distinguishes an unrelated candidate error from an error on the controlled child.
assessment.privacy: The exact-key schema permits only bounded counts, bool/null values, fixed phases/error enums and errno. Raw PID/UID/path/argv/environment and arbitrary exception text cannot enter this projection.
assessment.durability: The unittest parser projects the schema into the structured result; duplicate or malformed markers fail closed. Repetition receipts are appended even when the monitored test command fails.
assessment.cleanup: Streams are closed independently and exact-child cleanup is attempted after stream-close error. A cleanup or diagnostic-print failure cannot replace a pending primary failure in the reviewed normal failure path.
assessment.boundaries: Native discovery, resource API/limits, strict checkpoint eligibility, permissions, SDK lifetime and artifact retention are unchanged.

actualMacRequired.eachRepeat: One passed test, zero skips and exactly one schema-valid diagnostic with status passed.
actualMacRequired.then: The unchanged 60-second CPU/touched-memory/process-churn stress gate and known-child/background observations must succeed.
actualMacRequired.terminal: Safe receipt status passed, firstFailure null, monitorFailure null, exact child reaps and verified-gone group cleanup are required. Terminal evidence review remains necessary before any long-trial decision.

limitations: Instrumentation adds observation overhead and readiness/session preconditions; it preserves selection/API results but is not an identical timing replay.
Fixed Python exception kinds and errno are diagnostic classifications, not proof of the underlying kernel failure cause.
Short repeated success does not prove multi-hour build stability, checkpoint qualification or native authentication.
Long trials remain gated on stable short terminal evidence and a legitimate reviewed SDK acquisition path; this review covers only the short diagnosis.
